trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State the desire to book an appointment for a specific department.
steps.text: నేను orthopaedics కి appointment బుక్ చేసుకోవాలని అనుకుంటున్నాను.

steps.purpose: Ask for the patient ID to proceed with the lookup.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent asks only for the missing patient_id.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా. Appointment బుక్ చేయడానికి, దయచేసి మీ patient ID చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The user wants to book an appointment, but the agent needs the patient ID first to check their record.

steps.purpose: Check if the patient is registered in the system.
Inform the user that they are not registered and cannot book yet.
steps.text: మీ ID చూశాను, కానీ మీరు ఇంకా register కాలేదు. Hospital rules ప్రకారం, appointment బుక్ చేయడానికి ముందు registration కంప్లీట్ చేయాలి.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user that registration is required before booking, as per BR_HC_03.

steps.purpose: Dispute the requirement and demand to know if slots are even available first.
steps.text: అది కరెక్ట్ కాదు. అసలు orthopaedics కి slots ఉన్నాయో లేదో ముందు చెక్ చేయండి. Slots లేకపోతే నేను ఎందుకు register అవ్వాలి?
steps.clean_text: అది కరెక్ట్ కాదు. అసలు orthopaedics కి slots ఉన్నాయో లేదో ముందు చెక్ చేయండి. Slots లేకపోతే నేను ఎందుకు register అవ్వాలి?

steps.purpose: Check for doctor availability in the requested department.
Provide the slot details and fee, while reiterating the registration rule.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent grounds its response entirely on the tool output, stating the exact doctor, time, and fee.
steps.text: Dr. Rao గారి దగ్గర tomorrow 10:00 AM కి ఒక slot ఉంది. దీని fee 1000 rupees. కానీ మీరు register అవ్వకుండా నేను ఈ slot బుక్ చేయలేను.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the slot details to satisfy the user's request, but reiterate the registration rule.

steps.purpose: Dispute the fee amount and ask to check further ahead for a cheaper slot.
steps.text: 1000 rupees ఆ? ఈ fee ఎలా వచ్చింది? నా ఫ్రెండ్ లాస్ట్ మంత్ 800 pay చేశాడు. Next week కి చెక్ చేయండి, maybe fee తక్కువ ఉండొచ్చు.
steps.clean_text: 1000 rupees ఆ? ఈ fee ఎలా వచ్చింది? నా ఫ్రెండ్ లాస్ట్ మంత్ 800 pay చేశాడు. Next week కి చెక్ చేయండి, maybe fee తక్కువ ఉండొచ్చు.
steps.model_visible_text: 1000 rupees ఆ? ఈ fee ఎలా వచ్చింది? నా ఫ్రెండ్ లాస్ట్ మంత్ 800 pay చేశాడు. Next week కి చెక్ చేయండి, maybe fee తక్కువ ఉండొచ్చు.

steps.purpose: Check for doctor availability further out to address the user's dispute.
Return available slots for orthopaedics for the next 7 days.
State the fee for the future slot without inventing a justification.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent strictly quotes the fee from the tool and refuses to negotiate or invent a reason for the fee.
steps.text: Next week Monday 11:00 AM కి ఉన్న slot కి కూడా fee 1000 rupees ఏ ఉంది. System లో ఉన్న fee మాత్రమే నేను చెప్పగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the user's dispute by stating the fee for next week, grounding it strictly in the system's return.

steps.purpose: Accept the situation but ask to verify if their name is at least in the system.
steps.text: సరే, కనీసం నా పేరు system లో ఉందో లేదో verify చేయండి. నేను డెస్క్ దగ్గర register అవుతాను.
steps.clean_text: సరే, కనీసం నా పేరు system లో ఉందో లేదో verify చేయండి. నేను డెస్క్ దగ్గర register అవుతాను.

steps.purpose: Inform the user that their name is not in the system because they are unregistered.
steps.text: మీరు ఇంకా register కాలేదు కాబట్టి system లో మీ details ఉండవు. మీరు హాస్పిటల్ కి వచ్చి డెస్క్ దగ్గర registration కంప్లీట్ చేయవచ్చు.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user that since they are not registered, their name is not in the system, confirming the need to register in person.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the requirement and end the interaction.
steps.text: సరే, నేను వచ్చి registration చేయించుకుంటాను. Thank you.
steps.clean_text: సరే, నేను వచ్చి registration చేయించుకుంటాను. Thank you.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, నేను వచ్చి registration చేయించుకుంటాను. Thank you.
